claim: The Q1 of fiscal 2025 filing says Cisco recorded $0.68 in diluted EPS and $14 billion in revenue.
summary: The claim makes two assertions about Cisco Q1 FY2025 (quarter ended Oct 2024). GAAP diluted EPS of $0.68 is correct as reported, but reported revenue was $13.84 billion, not $14 billion; $14 billion is a rounded overstatement of ~$0.16B (~1.2%). Because one conjunct is inaccurate as stated, the combined claim is contradicted.

sub_claims.text: Cisco recorded $0.68 in diluted EPS in Q1 of fiscal 2025
sub_claims.note: Q1 FY2025 (quarter ended Oct 26, 2024) reported GAAP diluted EPS of $0.68 vs non-GAAP $0.91; the $0.68 figure matches GAAP diluted EPS.

sub_claims.text: Cisco recorded $14 billion in revenue in Q1 of fiscal 2025
sub_claims.note: Reported Q1 FY2025 total revenue was $13.84 billion ($13,842 million), not $14.0 billion; $14 billion only holds as a rounding to the nearest billion.
